key_decisions.decision: Bind both title records and opening; preserve all names, Joab, twelve thousand and divine agency without harmonizing Samuel.
Pinned qoshet truth chosen; alternate flee before bow requires note.
Follow read me versus written us, retain communal beloved and right hand.
Open divine speech and retain land allocation, holiness/sanctuary ambiguity noted.
Preserve four tribal/territorial names and head/staff authority images.
Pinned imperative over me retained despite difficult triumphant sense; do not harmonize Psalm 108.
Preserve rejected lament and absence, not force a confident answer.
